verdict.rationale: Sai documents that logins persist between sessions on its own VM or a BYOD device, so the agent can keep working behind authenticated sessions without being re-handed credentials each time. Nothing documents how credentials are entered, isolated from the model, or redacted from logs or transcripts, so the safety half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: a documented credential vault or human-entered login handoff, an explicit guarantee that secrets never reach model context, log or screenshot redaction, and independent corroboration.
